# AGENTS.md — @myorg/external

> The published package. Orientation in [README.md](./README.md), current state in [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md).

## Rules

- This is the only published package. Everything else in `packages/` is either private or inlined.
- Re-export explicitly — `export { greetUser } from "@myorg/internal"`. Never `export *`, which silently widens the public API every time an internal module changes.
- Never import `@myorg/internal` from an app. Apps import this package.
- A new export is a **minor** change and needs a changeset. A new subpath export needs the `exports` entry, the `bunup.config.ts` entry, and a changeset.
- Never add `typescript`, `bunup` or `@types/bun` here — `@myorg/ts` and `@myorg/bunup` own them.
- Never edit `dist/`; it is generated by `mbunup`.
- Keep the package tree-shakeable: no side effects at module scope in `src/`.
- Native bindings are optional at runtime — `src/native.ts` falls back to JS when the addon is unavailable. Keep that fallback.

## File layout

| Path | Role |
| :--- | :--- |
| `src/index.ts` | Public entry — explicit re-exports |
| `src/user.ts` | Domain types and functions |
| `src/native.ts` | Native wrapper with JS fallback |
| `tests/` | Bun tests |
| `bunup.config.ts` | Build entries |
| `tsconfig.json` | Extends `@myorg/ts/library.json` |

## Before marking a task done

- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] New or changed public export has a changeset
- [ ] No `export *` anywhere in `src/`
